decision.rationale: Linear fit on action-2+initial-0,1,2 has best BIC (-2429.7) and probe RMSE 0.0768 with no_mismatch_observed on action-2, quadratic_loss on same evidence is worse (-2417.4) with near-zero quadratic terms, but sensor_lag has only been fit on initial-0,1,2. Compare sensor_lag numerically on same full evidence before spending scarce experiments. Fitting is not confirmation.
